1. Gham Tumhara Sayyeda Ke Saath Jaayega
Qabr Me Tumhara Gham Mujhe Rulaega
Pursa Dene Bhi Tumhe Koi Na Aayega
Haaye
Shehr e Madina, Ghut Ke Hai Jeena..
Haye Ali Bekasi Teri..

2. Ek Wo Din Tha Mai Dulhan Ban Ke Aayi Thi
Aap Ke Ghar Ne Meri Izzat Badhayi Thi
Milke Mere Saath Ye Basti Basayi Thi
Shaam Se Pehle, Aapke Ghar Se, Fatima Khuda Ke Ghar Chali..

3. Dushman e Abu Turab Hai Yaha Tamam
Tum Pe Aach Aayegi Phir Bhi Na Aye Imam
Fatima Nay Kar Diya Hai Aisa Intezaam
Chaand Se Bete, Sadqe Tumhare
Ab Yahi Hai Jholi Me Meri

4. Baba Aaye The Abhi Dobara Aayenge
Keh Rahe The Kalmago Na Ab Sataenge
Fatima Tumhe Hum Aaj Leke Jayenge
Wada Kiya Tha, Baba Ne Jiska, Aagayi Hai Ab Wahi Ghadi..

5. Pyaas Se Hai Dekhte Mujhe Wo Baar Baar
Kar Liya Hussain or Hasan Ko Maine Pyaar
Maut Kar Rahi Hai Fatima Ka Intezaar
Maa Ko Tadapte, Dekhe Na Bachhe, Saanse Chal Rahi Hai Aakhri..

6. Ummat e Nabi Ne Mera Haal Ye Kiya
Jalta Dar Batool Par Gira Diya Gaya
Taziyana Bhi Laga Hai Haath Bhi Utha
Pehlu Shikasta, Bazu Shikasta
Fatima To Zakhm Ban Gayi ..(2)

7. Zakhm Dekh Kar Mere Abhi Se Hai Nidhaal
Maa Ke Gham Me Hogaya Hai Unka Ghair Haal
Baad Mere Betiyo'n Ka Rakhna Tum Khayal
Zainab o Kulsoom, Hai Abhi Masoom, Raah e Shaam Dur Hai Abhi..

Aap Se Chhupayi Hai Maine Har Jafa
Ghurbato Ka Hai Meri Gawaah Mujtaba
Kaise Bataun, Kaise Suna'un
Fatima Kaha'n Kaha'n Giri

9. Haye Dukhtar e Nabi Ko Qabr Me Utaar Kar

Hogayi Tamaam Qabr Aansuo'n Se Tarr
Uth Ke Qabr Se Jab Ali Chale, Thi Yahi Sadaa Batool Ki..
